subject: Offer call availability + e-sign timeline and start-date window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@gmail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:15:00Z
Subject: Offer details and quick availability for a call

Hi Eli —

Thanks again for the great conversations with the team. We’d like to schedule a 30-minute offer call to walk through the offer letter, relocation details, and start-date options. Proposed windows (PT):

- Mon 11/29, 10:00–10:30
- Mon 11/29, 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11/30, 09:00–09:30

I’ve attached the initial offer draft (RF_Offer_Redwood_SeniorInfraEngineer_v1.pdf) for your review. Key items covered: base, sign-on, equity outline, 16 days PTO (pro-rated), and relocation stipend guidance.

If you prefer, we can send the DocuSign envelope after the call so you can ask questions in real time; alternatively, we can share the e-sign link in advance if you’d like to review/redline beforehand. If you have specific items you already want addressed (vacation accrual, bonus timing, early start), list them in your reply and we’ll loop the right folks in.

Agenda (draft):
- Go over comp and equity summary
- Relocation & stipend details
- Start-date options and payroll cutover
- Next steps & DocuSign timing

Thanks — I’ll hold the 11/29 times until I hear from you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: RF_Offer_Redwood_SeniorInfraEngineer_v1.pdf
From: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Offer details and quick availability for a call

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate this and the fast follow. I can do Mon 11/29 at 10:00 PT. A couple quick Qs after a first skim of the PDF:

1) The base listed is $185k but in our last call Jordan mentioned $190k. Is the $185k final or is that the draft number?
2) Is the sign-on bonus payable in first payroll or split?
3) PTO: is there any faster accrual for experienced hires or is prorated the standard?

Also — if possible I’d like the DocuSign link in advance so I can review the precise language around relocation and vesting; if you prefer to wait until after the call that’s fine.

Thanks — looking forward to the chat.

— Eli
Eli Ramirez
Senior Systems Engineer
elli.ramirez@gmail.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Offer details and quick availability for a call

Marissa / Mina —

Thanks Marissa. I’m aligned with the 10:00 PT slot on 11/29 and will join to cover the scope around compensation philosophy. Mina, could you be on the call to confirm payroll and sign-on timing (and to answer Eli’s accrual question)? If possible, please bring the corrected compsheet — there may have been an earlier mis-communication on the base.

I’ve attached a short proposed-call-agenda.txt (bullet points) we can use to keep the call tight. If Eli wants the DocuSign before the call, recommend we send v2 with a short note that redlines should be emailed to offers@redwood.ai so Legal can triage pre-call.

Jordan Blake
Head of Eng Hiring, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Attachments: proposed-call-agenda.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@gmail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Clarke <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T07:50:00Z
Subject: Confirming 11/29 10:00 PT + updated draft offer (v2)

Hi Eli —

Great — confirmed for Mon 11/29 at 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-offer-call-1129

I’ve attached v2 of the offer (RF_Offer_Redwood_SeniorInfraEngineer_v2.pdf) — this includes the corrected base ($190,000) and the explicit payout schedule for the sign-on (one-time in first payroll). We also added an explicit clause about pro-rated PTO for the hire month and a relocation stipend note.

Per Jordan’s note, we can either:
- Send DocuSign tonight so you can review and optionally sign (recommended if you want to get ahead), or
- Send DocuSign after the call and incorporate any redlines discussed.

If you want to review now, reply and I’ll send the e-sign envelope to this email; otherwise we’ll wait until after the call and capture any edits then. Rebecca (cc) is Eli’s recruiter; Rebecca — FYI on scheduling and the compensation update.

Thanks — talk Monday.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: RF_Offer_Redwood_SeniorInfraEngineer_v2.pdf
From: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Clarke <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T17:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Confirming 11/29 10:00 PT + updated draft offer (v2)

Marissa / Jordan —

Thanks for the update and for correcting the base. I can take the call in the morning but two quick asks before we talk (hope that’s ok):

1) Start date — my current employer’s notice window ends Dec 31. I can be available to start either Jan 2 (if payroll/holiday processing allows) or Jan 5. I’d prefer Jan 2 if possible given family relocation timing.
2) Relocation — could you confirm whether the stipend is paid on hire or reimbursed after receipts? The doc shows both phrasing.
3) PTO — will it be pro-rated to the 16 days on day-one, or will accrual begin after the first payroll?

If you’re willing to send the DocuSign link in advance I’ll take a look and might send a short redline (language around reimbursement). If not, I’m fine waiting until we chat.

— Eli
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Clarke <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T20:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Confirming 11/29 10:00 PT + updated draft offer (v2)

Eli —

Appreciate the heads-up on timing. Short answers:
- Start date: Jan 2 is potentially OK but we need payroll to confirm; Jan 5 is the conservative default. I asked Mina to check payroll cutover and confirm by tomorrow morning so we can lock the start date.
- Relocation stipend: Clara in Finance clarified that stipends are paid in the first payroll as a one-time payment when the employee is onboarded; if receipts are required for part reimbursement we’ll note that explicitly in the final DocuSign.
- PTO: standard at Redwood is pro-rated for the first partial month and then accrual thereafter; the v2 text attempts to capture that, but we’ll clarify exact accrual dates in the envelope.

Marissa will send the DocuSign envelope tonight to eli.ramirez@gmail.com with a note that any redlines should be emailed to offers@redwood.ai; Legal will triage urgent redlines same day. If you do request a small language tweak around reimbursement, that’s fine — we’ll route it through Legal for a quick sign-off.

Look forward to speaking Monday.

Jordan Blake
Head of Eng Hiring, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Attachments: e-sign-invite-placeholder.txt
